[$GLOBALS Assignement](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/GLOBALSAssignement.html): It is not possible to assign the `$GLOBALS` variable anymore.
[$http_response_header Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/http_response_header.html): The $http_response_header PHP variable is deprecated.
[$php_errormsg has been removed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/php_errormsg.html): $php_errormsg used to hold the message of the last error that PHP emitted.
[$this Must Be The Local Object](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/thisMustBeInObject.html): `$this` used to be a variable like any other, except for being filled with the local object in a method.
[${expression} is deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dollar_curly_expression.html): The `$\{}` allowed the usage of an expression to be used as the name of a variable, inside de double quoted string.
[(real) Is Replaced By (float)](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/real_cast.html): (real) is replaced by (float) in PHP 8.
[(unset) Was Removed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unset_cast.html): (unset) operator is removed.
[::class On Object](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ClassOnIdentifier.html): The ::class operator provides the fully qualified name of the identifier or object.
[Accessing Directly Properties In Trait](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/callToTraitProperty.html): I was possible, though deprecated, to manipulate directly trait properties: the static properties.
[Accessing Trait Resources Directly Is Not Allowed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/accessTraitsDirectly.html): It is not possible anymore to use traits just like a standalone class.
[Alias Replace Class](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/aliasReplace.html): When a class is defined before an alias, with `use`, it used to yield a fatal error.
[Anonymous Class Name Includes Extends](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/anonymousSignature.html): The fully qualified name of an anonymous class (sic) includes the parent class as the first part of the name, since PHP 8.
[Appending To $GLOBALS](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/GLOBALSAppend.html): $GLOBALS is not a regular array: each of its entries is really a reference to a variable in the global scope, identified by its name.
[Array Has No Absolute Name](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/absoluteArrayName.html): Classes may be used as type, with an optional leading `\`.
[Array Syntax With Curly Braces Are No More](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/curly_braces.html): Using the array syntax with curly braces used to yield a Fatal error, and a nice error message.
[Array Usage With String Initialisation](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/array_with_string_initialisation.html): String and arrays share the same syntax when using integer index: it accesses one element in the array or string, to reading or modifying.
[Auto-initialization From Boolean](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/autoInitializeArrayFromBool.html): The auto-initialization is the conversion a boolean `false` or `true`, to an array, by using the array syntax on it.
[Automatic Index In Non Empty Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/array_next_id.html): When starting from an array whose maximum key is integer and negative, PHP used to continue assigning indices with 0, instead of the following negative number.
[Back-tick Operator Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/backtick.html): The back tick operator is deprecated, and will be removed in PHP 9.
[Backed Enum Values Needed To Compile](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/backed_enum_constant_check.html): In PHP 8.
[Base Conversion Reports Invalid Characters](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/InvalidBaseCharacter.html): The base conversion functions, such as octdec(), base_convert(), binhex() or hexdex() used to ignore silently invalid characters.
[Bitshift And Concat Precedence](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/bitshiftConcatPrecedence.html): << and >> and.
[Boolean Used As Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/BooleanAsArray.html): Booleans, `true` and `false` are not an array, but it is possible to use the array syntax with it.
[Call Method On New](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/newThenMethodCall.html): It was not possible to call a method directly after instantiating an object: the instantiation had to be done within a parenthesis.
[Calling Non-Static Method Statically](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/callingNonStaticMethodStatically.html): Calling non-static method statically has been deprecated for a long time.
[Calling Static Methods On Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/InterpolatedStringMethodcall.html): The left operand of the `::` operator for methods could not be a literal string, until PHP 8.
[Can Clone Readonly Properties](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/cloneReadonly.html): Readonly properties may be changed, both at constructor and cloning time, since PHP 8.
[Cannot Bind $this To Static Closure](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticClosureBinding.html): A static closure does not import any variables from the defining context.
[Cannot Call Traits Methods Directly](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/callTraitAlone.html): Traits used to be called directly, like a class.
[Cannot Explode() Null](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/explodeWithNull.html): Null used to be a valid argument for explode(), used as an empty string.
[Cannot Raise Zero To Negative Powers](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/zeroToNegativePower.html): Raising 0 to a negative power used to generate a `INF` value, aka infinity.
[Cast In Const](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/castInConst.html): PHP 8.
[Catch Without Variable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/CatchNoVariable.html): A catch clause doesn't require a storing variable anymore.
[Clone A Constant](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/cloneConstant.html): Cloning a constant was useless until PHP 8.
[Comment Inside yield from](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/yield_comment_from.html): Since PHP 8.
[Constant %s is deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/deprecatedConstant.html): With new versions, PHP deprecates some constants.
[Constants In Trait](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ConstantInTrait.html): Trait can have constants in PHP 8.
[Constants In Traits](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/traitWithConstants.html): Constants are allowed in traits in PHP 8.
[Constants With Objects](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/constWithObjects.html): Global constants are allowed to use an object, starting with PHP 8.
[Copy Of $GLOBALS](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/GLOBALSCopy.html): Cpying $GLOBALS into another variable was made by reference: modifying the values in the copy was also modifying the original.
[Covariance And Contravariance Are Fatal](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/liskovPrinciple.html): Type mismatch between signatures of the same method in different classes of the same hierarchy used to be a warning.
[Creating Object On Null](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/creatingObjectOnNull.html): It was possible to create an object just like a variable: simply by assigning a value to one property.
[DOM Readonly Properties Use Asymmetric Visibility](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/domAsymmetricVisibility.html): Properties previously documented as readonly, such as `DOMNode::$nodeType`, `DOMDocument::$xmlEncoding`, `DOMEntity::$actualEncoding`, `$encoding` and `$version`, are now declared with asymmetric visibility (`public private(set)`).
[Default Values With htmlspecialchars()](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/htmlspecialchars81.html): The default values of htmlspecialchars() were changed in PHP 8.
[Destructuring Non Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/destructuringNonArray.html): Destructuring non array values emits a warning in PHP 8.
[Die And Exit As Functions](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/die-exit-functions.html): Die and Exit used to be language constructs, a special kind of PHP instructions.
[Direct calls on new](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/new_then_invoke.html): Calling an object directly upon instantiation was not possible in PHP 8.
[Dot And Bitshift Priority](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dotAndBitshift.html): The dot (concatenation) and bitshift (<< and >>) operators have a distinct priority in PHP.
[Dot And Minus Changed Precedence](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dotAndMinus.html): The dot (concatenation) and substraction - operators have a distinct priority in PHP 8.
[Dot And Plus Changed Precedence](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dotAndPlus.html): The dot (concatenation) and addition + operators have a distinct priority in PHP 8.
[Duplicate Enum Cases Are Not Linted Anymore](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/linted_enum.html): Two different cases in an enumeration cannot have duplicate values.
[Duplicate Static Definition](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/duplicateStaticDefinition.html): PHP reports when the same static variable has been declared twice in the same context.
[Dynamic Class Constant](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dynamicClassConstant.html): To access a constant value with its name in a string, one required the constant() function.
[E_STRICT Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/e_strict.html): The PHP native constant `E_STRICT` is deprecated, and will be removed in PHP 9.
[E_USER_ERROR Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/E_USER_ERROR.html): The PHP native constant E_USER_ERROR is deprecated.
[Enforcing Native PHP ReturnType](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/enforceNativeReturnType.html): PHP did not enforce the return types in its own interfaces.
[Enforcing Return Type With Spl Classes](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/enforceSplReturnType.html): The types of the methods that were related to SPL were not validated against their interfaced.
[Enums May Now Define __debugInfo()](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/enumDebugInfo86.html): Declaring the magic method `__debugInfo()` on an `enum` used to be a compile-time fatal error, because enum cases were treated like other magic methods that make no sense on enums.
[FilessytemIterator Skips Dot Files](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/filessytemiteratorSkipDot.html): FilessytemIterator class used to list the current directory `.
[Final Class Constants](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/finalClassConstants.html): Class constants can be made final, starting with PHP 8.
[Final Method In Trait](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/finalMethodInTrait.html): Trait methods can be named final, when importing them as a trait alias.
[Final Promoted Properties](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/finalPromotedProperties.html): Promoted properties could not be final until PHP 8.
[Finfo Moved Away From Resource](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/finfo_open.html): `Finfo` functions have moved from resource to objects in PHP 8.
[First-Class Callables Inside Constant Expressions Must Resolve To A Literal Method Name](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/constantExpressionMethodNameResolution85.html): PHP 8.
[Float Used As Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/FloatAsArray.html): A float is not an array, but it is possible to use the array syntax with it.
[GMP Shift Operators Validate A GMP Right Operand](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/gmpShiftValueError86.html): The GMP shift operators (`<<` and `>>`) accept a right operand outside the range of a regular PHP integer when it is itself a `GMP` object.
[Generators Don't Return](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/generatorDontReturn.html): In PHP 5.
[Heredoc Syntax In An Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/heredoc_in_array.html): It was only possible to use the HEREDOC, and NOWDOC, syntax with a final semicolon.
[Implicit Array Key Conversion](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/implicitConversionToInt.html): Array keys accept only string and integer types.
[Implicit Nullable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/implicitNullable.html): A typed argument with a default value of `null` was also implicitly nullable: it would accept null as a value.
[Increment Non-alphanumeric](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/incrementNonAlphanumeric.html): PHP has a string increment feature, where a string may be incremented by one, to its next ASCII character.
[Increment On Boolean Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/incrementOnBoolean.html): Incrementing or decrementing a boolean value had no effect.
[Indirect Modification In Clone](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/indirectModificationInClone.html): __clone is used to apply modifications during the cloning operation.
[Inegality Comparisons](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/inegalityComparison.html): The loose comparisons, including `=`, between integers and strings have changed in PHP 8.
[Init Readonly Properties In Child Class](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/initReadonlyInChild.html): Readonly properties used to be only assigned a value in their definition class.
[Integer Non-silent Conversion](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/intSilentConversion.html): When a string is converted into a integer, with problems, the notice was upgraded to a Warning.
[Integer Regex With mb_ereg_replace()](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/mb_ereg_replaceWithInteger.html): mb_ereg_replace() used to accept an integer as a regex.
[Integer Used As Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/IntAsArray.html): An integer is not an array, but it is possible to use the array syntax with it.
[Interface Constant Visibility Checks](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/interfaceConstantVisibilityCheck.html): PHP checks if the visibility of constants that are also part of an interface are all public.
[Interface Imported Constant Visibility Is Checked](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/constantFromInterfaceVisibilityCheck.html): Constant and methods visibility must be public when they are defined in an interface.
[Interpolated String Dereferencing](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/InterpolatedStringDereferencing.html): It was not possible to use a literal string as a variable for an array, or a class name, and access, respectively, index, properties, constant or methods.
[Keywords In Namespace](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/keywordInNamespace.html): PHP didn't accept its own keywords in the definition of a namespace.
[Length Of tempnam() Has Been Raised](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/tempnamLength.html): The temporary name, provided by `tempname()` used to be 6 characters, added to the provided prefix.
[Magic Method __debugInfo() cannot return null](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/debugInfoCannotReturnNull.html): __debugInfo() is a magic method that returns an array with debug information.
[Method export() in Reflection Is removed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/exportReflection.html): The `Reflection::export()` static method was deprecated in PHP 7.
[Named Parameters And Variadic](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/named_parameters_and_variadic.html): It is possible to use the three dots `.
[Negative Automatic Index From Empty Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/array_negative_id.html): When starting from an empty array and assigning an initial negative integer index, PHP used to continue assigning indices with 0, instead of the following negative number.
[Negative Index On Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/negativeIndex.html): Negative index reaches an offset in a string, starting from the last elements in that string, instead of starting from position 0.
[Negative Offset With Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/negativeOffsetOnStrings.html): Negative offsets on strings were introduced in PHP 7.
[Nested Attributes](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/nestedAttributes.html): Attributes can handle nested `new` calls since PHP 8.
[Never Arrow Function](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/neverArrowFunction.html): The never type requires the closure to not return, but the arrow function always returns something.
[New Cases In Switch](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/newCasesInSwitch.html): With PHP 8.
[No Abstract Private Method In Traits](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/abstractPrivateMethodInTrait.html): It was not possible to have abstract private methods in a trait.
[No Case With A Semi-colon](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/case-with-semicolon.html): It was little known that one could use a semi-colon `.
[No Dynamic Global Variables](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/globalDynamicVariable.html): In PHP 5.
[No Dynamic Properties By Default](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dynamicProperties.html): Properties never required a definition before usage, just like variables.
[No Max() On Empty Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/maxOnEmpty.html): max() does not accept an empty array as argument.
[No More dir() With Null](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dirWithNull.html): When calling `dir()` with `null` as parameter, it defaulted to open again the last opened directory.
[No New Line In Namespaces](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/MultilineQualifiedName.html): It was possible to use new lines inside a namespace: they would be removed at execution time, to build the actual namespace.
[No Reference To $GLOBALS Variable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/NoReferenceToGLOBALS.html): Since PHP 8.
[No min() On Empty Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/minOnEmpty.html): min() does not accept an empty array as argument.
[Non Static Method Called Statically](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/nonStaticMethodCalledStatically.html): It is not possible to call a non-static method statically, and now, it is also not possible to call non-statically a static method.
[Non-canonical Cast](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/nonCanonicalCast.html): Non canonical cast operators `(integer)`, `(binary)`, `(double)`, `(boolean)` are deprecated, since PHP 8.
[Not In A Closure](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/NotAClosure.html): Calling `Closure` native methods outside a closure or an arrow function leads to an error message.
[Null As Array Offset](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/NullAsArrayOffset.html): Array indices may be integers or strings.
[Null Used As Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/NullAsArray.html): Null is not an array, but it is possible to use the array syntax with it.
[Null With array_key_exists()](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/NullWithArrayKeyExists.html): `null` is not accepted anymore as the first argument of the PHP native function `array_key_exists()`.
[Old Constructors](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/OldConstructors.html): In PHP 4, the constructor was the method of the same name as the class.
[Old Style Constructor](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/oldStyleConstructor.html): Since PHP 5, the constructor method of a class was the eponymous method: the method with the same name as the class.
[Only First Byte](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/onlyFirstByte.html): When assigning a string to a position inside another string, PHP reports a warning: indeed, only the first byte is used.
[Optional Parameter Are After Compulsory Parameters](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/OptionalParameterLast.html): Optional parameters have a default value.
[Orphaned Parent](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/orphanedParent.html): Calling the parent class of a class without parent is not possible.
[Override Attribute Extended To Class Constants And Enum Cases](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/overrideAttributeOnConstant86.html): The `#[\Override]` attribute, introduced in PHP 8.
[Override Attribute Extended To Properties](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/overrideAttributeOnProperty85.html): The `#[\Override]` attribute, introduced in PHP 8.
[PHP 8.5 split the missing-abstract-method message by declaration kind](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/abstractMethodMessageSplit85.html): Before PHP 8.
[PHP Constants Are Not Case Insensitive](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/caseInsensitiveDefine.html): PHP allowed the creation of case-insensitive constants with the function `define`.
[PHP Warns When Finding Unconvertible Characters](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/octalNonConvertible.html): PHP emits a deprecation when reaching a character that cannot be converted.
[PHP native return types are now enforced](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/returnTypeEnforce.html): PHP provides native interfaces: they include methods and their type.
[Parameter Contravariance](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/contravarianceParameter.html): PHP 7.
[Passing Objects Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/passingObjectIsDeprecated.html): Several array functions, such as `current`, `next`, `prev`, `reset` used to accept both objects and arrays.
[Plus And Concat Precedence](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/plusConcatPrecedence.html): `+` (and `-`) and `.
[Recursive Comparison Of Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/recursiveComparison.html): Recursive arrays should not be compared one another, as the engine might ends in an infinite loop.
[Reflection Doesn't Return Self](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/reflection_self.html): Reflection used to return the original `self` type, including its case.
[Reflection Doesn't Return Static](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/reflection_static.html): Reflection used to return the original `static` type, including its case.
[Relative Callable In Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/relativeCallable.html): PHP has a syntax to designate a method, with its class and method name as a string.
[Relaxed Naming With Class Constant](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/relaxed_private.html): Relaxed naming is the possibility to use PHP keywords as method or class constant names (for properties, the `$` has allowed it for a long time).
[Removing $this from a closure is deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/UnbindingThis.html): When a closure is created in a non-static method, it imports automatically the current object.
[Return Reference On Void](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/return_reference_on_void.html): There are methods that return void.
[Returning A Value From A Constructor Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/constructorReturnDeprecated.html): A constructor's return value was always ignored by PHP, silently.
[Returntype Covariance](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/covarianceReturntype.html): PHP 7.
[Session Cookies Default To Secure Settings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/sessionSecurityDefaults.html): The built-in defaults of three session INI settings changed to provide secure behavior out of the box: `session.
[Sorting Closure Must Return Integers](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/sortClosureReturnType.html): Comparison closures used in custom sorting need to return an integer, while they used to yield true or false.
[Spaces In Namespaces](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/spaces_in_namespaces.html): It used to be valid syntax to have a new line or a space in a namespace name.
[SplFileObject::next() Always Advances The Stream](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/splFileObjectNextCaching86.html): `SplFileObject::next()` used to only advance to the next line when a prior `current()` call had already cached a line internally.
[SplFixedArray Is Now An IteratorAggregate](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/splfixedarray.html): SplFixedArray` used to be an `Iterator`, and is now an `IteratorAggregate`.
[SplObjectStorage::getHash() May No Longer Mutate Storage](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/splObjectStorageGetHashMutation86.html): A custom `getHash()` implementation in an `SplObjectStorage` subclass used to be free to mutate any `SplObjectStorage` instance, including a different one than the one currently being hashed, while computing the hash.
[Static Properties With Asymmetric Visibility](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/asymmetricStatic.html): Asymmetric visibility was introduced in version 8.
[Static Properties With References](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticWithReference.html): Static properties are shared between inheriting classes.
[Static Variable Accepts Functioncalls As Default](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticVariableWithArbitraryDefault.html): Static variables are actually variables: as such, they can be inited with the result of a functioncall.
[Static Variables Are Linked To Their Method](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticInInheritedMethods.html): Static variables are linked to their method: any call to that method should access the same property.
[Storage Of Static Properties Trait](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticTraitStorage.html): Static properties defined in a trait used to be merged with any existing static property in a parent class.
[String Increments](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/stringIncrement.html): String increments are the `++` operator applied to a string.
[String To Integer Comparison](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/stringIntegerComparison.html): The comparison between a string and an integer has changed.
[Strings Are Bigger Than Integers](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/stringsBiggerThanIntegers.html): When comparing strings and integers with inequalities (`<`, `=<`, `>`, `>=`), strings used to be smaller than numbers and they are bigger than numbers in PHP 8.
[Tentative Static Returntype With Datetime](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/tentativeStaticWithDatetime.html): The `createFromImmutable()` method from `DateTime` and `DateTimeImmutable` always return an object of the same class.
[Ternary Associativity](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ternaryAssociativity.html): The ternary operator used to have a left associativity : it would process first the `then` and `else` clauses, before executing itself.
[Trailing Comma In Arguments](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/trailingCommaInArguments.html): Trailing comma in arguments is the last argument left empty.
[Trailing Comma In Calls](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/trailingCommaInCalls.html): Trailing commas in parameters is the last parameter left empty.
[Typed Class Constant](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/typedClassConstant.html): Support for typed class constants was added in PHP 8.
[Undefined Constants](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/undefinedConstants.html): Undefined global constants used to fallback to their equivalent string.
[Underscore Named Class](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ClassUnderscore.html): It is not possible to name a class `_` underscore anymore.
[Unpack Array With String Keys](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unpack_arrays_with_strings.html): In PHP 7.
[Unpack Arrays In Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unpack_arrays.html): The ellipsis operator can now be used in arrays, with an effect similar to array_merge().
[Unserialize with the upper case S is deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unserialize_S.html): When using the unserialize() function, the string should not use `S` (upper case S) to format a string.
[Using __autoload() is deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/autoload.html): Defining the `__autoload()` function used to be the way to create a autoloading mechanism for classes, traits, interfaces and enumerations.
[WeakMap Allows Reference Assignment To A Missing Key](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/weakMapReferenceAssign86.html): Taking a reference to a `WeakMap` offset with `=&` used to require the key to already be present in the map, otherwise PHP threw an `Error` saying the object was not contained in the `WeakMap`.
[Yield Must Use Integer Or String Keys](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/mustYieldIntOrStringKeys.html): A generator is unpacked as an array, and as such, it doesn't allow keys to be anything else but string or integer.
[__FUNCTION__ In Closure Changed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/magicConstantInClosure.html): When using the magic constant `__FUNCTION__` inside a closure, the content used to be the `{closure}` string only.
[__debugInfo() Nullable Return Type Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/debugInfoNullableDeprecated.html): The magic method `__debugInfo()` used to be freely typed to return `.
[__set_state() Method Must Be Static](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/set_state_must_be_static.html): Starting with PHP 8.
[__sleep() Method Enforces Return Type](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/nonArrayWithSleep.html): __sleep is a magic method that lists the name of the variables to serialize.
[__toString Can Throw Exceptions](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/toStringCanThrow.html): The magic method `__toString()` could not throw exception, in case of problem occurring during processing.
[array And callable Cannot Be Absolute](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/absolute_array.html): `array` and `callable` cannot be an absolute type, with the leading backslash.
[array_change_key_case() Validates Its Case Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/arrayChangeKeyCaseValueError.html): `array_change_key_case()` accepts a second argument, either `CASE_LOWER` or `CASE_UPPER`.
[array_filter() Validates Its Mode Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/arrayFilterModeValueError.html): `array_filter()` accepts a third argument that selects which values are passed to the callback: `ARRAY_FILTER_USE_VALUE`, `ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY`, or `ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH`.
[array_intersect() Converts Values While Scanning Inputs](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/arrayIntersectConversionTiming86.html): `array_intersect()` compares values as strings.
[array_key_exists() doesn't work on objects](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/array_key_existsOnObjects.html): array_key_exists() used to accept arrays and objects, and worked on them indistinctly.
[array_merge() And Variadic](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/array_merge_and_variadic.html): array_merge() always needed at least one argument to execute.
[array_product() New Checks](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/arrayProdChecks.html): array_product() used to cast the arguments to integers before executing the multiplications.
[array_sum() Checks Operands Thoroughly](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/arraySumChecks.html): array_sum() used to cast the arguments to integers before executing the additions.
[assert Is Reserved Function](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/assertIsReserved.html): It is not possible to create a function named `assert` anymore in PHP 8.
[assert() Throws Exception](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/assertThrows.html): assert() is the PHP native implementation of assertions.
[cUrl Moved Away From Resource](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/curl_init.html): Curl functions have moved from resource to objects in PHP 8.
[ceil() Strict Mode](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ceilStrictMode.html): ceil() doesn't accept internal objects that can be converted to integer.
[class_alias() Works On Internal Classes](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/classAliasWithInternalClass.html): class_alias() makes an alias for a class, an enumeration, an interface or a trait.
[compact() Throws Notice On Missing Variable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/compactThrowsNotice.html): compact() collects variables in an array.
[convert_uuencode() Works On Empty Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/convert_uuencode.html): convert_uuencode() returned false, aka error, when provided with an empty string.
[count() Must Count Countable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/countUncountable.html): PHP used to count any kind of value.
[datetime With Multiple Signs](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/datetimeWithMultipleSigns.html): There can be only one sign character, when instantiating a DateTime object.
[dl() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Extension Filename](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/dlNullByteValueError.html): `dl()` used to accept an extension filename containing a NUL byte and only reported the standard warning once `enable_dl` turned out to be off.
[each() Has Been Removed](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/each.html): The `each()` function has been deprecated in PHP 7.
[each() Is No More](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/while_list_each.html): The `each` function is the base for the `while` loop that traverse arrays.
[eval() Without Try](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/EvalWithouTry.html): The `eval()` command throws an error in case of unparsable PHP code.
[explode() Forbids Empty Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/explodeWithEmptyString.html): explode() doesn't work on empty strings, as delimiter (first argument).
[file_get_contents() Needs A Real Path](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/file_get_contents.html): file_get_contents() cannot work on an empty string.
[fputcsv() Needs Escape Parameter](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/fputcsvEscape.html): fputcsv().
[func_get_arg() Changed Behavior](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/func_get_arg.html): `func_get_arg()` and `func_get_args()` used to report the calling value of the argument, until PHP 7.
[get_called_class() Cannot Be Called Outside A Class](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/get_called_class_outside_class.html): get_called_class() generated a warning when called outside a class or an enumeration.
[get_class() Needs An Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/get_classWithoutArgument.html): get_class() had a default behavior, where the current class would be returned when get_class() is called without arguments.
[get_defined_functions() Doesn't Exclude Diabled Functions Anymore](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/get_defined_functions.html): get_defined_functions() used to have one parameter, called `$exclude_disabled`.
[get_object_vars() Does Not Work On ArrayObject](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/getObjectVars.html): `ArrayObject` used to export its properties as they were defined in the array.
[getenv() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Variable Name](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/getenvNullByteValueError.html): `getenv()` used to accept a variable name containing a NUL byte, and simply returned `false` since no such variable can exist.
[hexdec() Warns When The Result Loses Precision](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/hexdecImpreciseNotice86.html): `hexdec()`, `bindec()`, `octdec()` and `base_convert()` return a `float` when the converted number is too large to fit in a PHP integer.
[http_build_query() supports enumerations](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/http_build_query_and_enum.html): `http_build_query()` accepted backed enumerations, and used to produce a query string with a `b` array, containing `value` and `name`.
[implode() Arguments Order](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/imploderOrder.html): It was possible to call implode() with a random order of argument : string first, or array first.
[in_array() Doesn't Confuse 0 And Empty String](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/inArrayZeroString.html): in_array() makes a relaxed comparison of values in its arguments.
[in_array() String Int Comparisons](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/inArrayStringIng.html): The default comparison style of in_array() is the relaxed one.
[ini_get_all() Includes The Built-in Default Value](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/iniGetAllBuiltinDefault.html): `ini_get_all()` used to return, for each directive, only the `global_value`, `local_value` and `access` keys.
[instanceof Expect Objects](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/instanceofExpectObjects.html): PHP used to report a fatal error when provided with a value that is not an object.
[isset() On Constants](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/issetWithConstant.html): It was not possible to use isset() on a constant.
[isset()-Materialized Magic Property Skips __get()](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/magicPropertyIssetGet86.html): `.
[iterator_count() Also Count Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/iteratorsArray.html): The PHP native function used to accept only iterators.
[jsonSerialize Must Have Return Type](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/jsonSerialize.html): PHP used to not enforce the type compatibility between a native interface and its custom implementation.
[krsort() Places Integers Before Strings In Keys](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/krsort.html): krsort() used the PHP 7 way to compare values: then, strings would rank below integers, in particular below 0.
[ksort() Now Places Integers Before Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ksort.html): ksort() used the PHP 7 way to compare values: then, strings would rank below integers, in particular below 0.
[ksort() now uses regular comparison](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/ksort-regular.html): ksort() used a different sorting method to sort the keys than to sort the values.
[libxml_disable_entity_loader() Is Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/libxml_disable_entity_loader.html): libxml_disable_entity_loader() has been deprecated since PHP 8.
[linkinfo() Rejects An Empty Path](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/linkinfoEmptyPathValueError.html): `linkinfo()` used to accept an empty string as its path argument, emit a warning and return `-1`.
[match Is Now A Keyword](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/matchKeyword.html): Match() was introduced in PHP 8.
[max() Must Contain At Least One Element](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/maxOnEmptyArray.html): max() returns the largest value in the argument.
[max() On String And Integer](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/maxOnStringAndInt.html): In PHP 8, the rules of comparison between integers and strings have changed.
[mb_convert_encoding() Has Deprecated Formats](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/mb_convert_encoding.html): 4 previous formats have been removed from `mb_convert_encoding()` options: `uuencode`, `base64`, `qprint`, `html`.
[mb_strrpos() Third Argument Is Not Encoding](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/mb_strrpos.html): The third argument of mb_strrpos() was the offset where to start the search in the string.
[min() Doesn't Accept Empty Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/minOnEmptyArray.html): min() doesn't accept empty arrays anymore.
[mixed Is Now A Keyword](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/mixedKeyword.html): mixed was introduced in PHP 8.
[namespace Is Not Valid As A Class Constant Name](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/namespaceClassConst.html): namespace is a PHP keyword, and it is allowed inside class for naming methods or properties.
[never Is Now A Keyword](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/neverKeyword.html): Never became a PHP reserved keyword in PHP 8.
[number_format() Validates Its Decimals Argument Range](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/numberFormatDecimalsValueError.html): `number_format()`'s `$decimals` argument is internally clamped to a 32-bit signed integer range (-2147483648 to 2147483647).
[openlog() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Prefix](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/openlogNullByteValueError.html): `openlog()` used to accept a syslog prefix containing a NUL byte and silently truncated it at the NUL byte.
[parent Cannot Be Used Anymore In Callable Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/parentInCallable.html): PHP supports a callable syntax, based on array: it must be an array of two elements, where the index 0 is the object or the class, and the index 1 is the method name.
[parse_str() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Query String](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/parseStrNullByteValueError.html): `parse_str()` used to accept a query string containing a NUL byte and silently parsed only the part before it.
[pathinfo() Validates Its Flags Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/pathinfoFlagsValueError.html): `pathinfo()` accepts a second argument made of `PATHINFO_*` constants.
[preg_grep() Returns false On A PCRE Execution Error](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/pregGrepPcreError86.html): `preg_grep()` filters an array using a regular expression.
[printf() Warns About Unknown Formats](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/printfWarning.html): printf(), and its related functions, reports unknown format specifiers.
[proc_open() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Working Directory](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/procOpenCwdNullByteValueError.html): `proc_open()` used to accept a `$cwd` argument containing a NUL byte and passed the truncated path straight to the operating system, which then failed to spawn the process.
[putenv() Rejects NUL Bytes In The Assignment](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/putenvNullByteValueError.html): `putenv()` used to accept an assignment string containing a NUL byte and silently truncated it at the NUL byte, setting an environment variable from the part before it.
[range() Lists Everything Between Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/rangeWithAllStrings.html): range() used to cast the arguments to integers.
[range() Uses Single Byte Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/rangeSingleByteString.html): When the first argument of range() is a single byte string, then the second argument must also be a single byte string, to keep the range consistent.
[range() With Int And String](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/rangeWithIntAndString.html): range() now emits a warning when one of the arguments is a string, and the other is an integer.
[round() Mode Validation](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/roundParameterValidation.html): The `round()` function has four modes, defined with four constants.
[scandir() Validates Its Sorting Order Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/scandirSortingOrderValueError.html): `scandir()` accepts a second argument that selects the sort order of the returned entries: `SCANDIR_SORT_ASCENDING`, `SCANDIR_SORT_DESCENDING`, or `SCANDIR_SORT_NONE`.
[self Cannot Be Used Anymore In Callable Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/selfInCallable.html): PHP supports a callable syntax, based on array: it must be an array of two elements, where the index 0 is the object or the class, and the index 1 is the method name.
[set_exception_handler() Must Update Its Type To Throwable](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/setExceptionHandlerType.html): All thrown issues were children of the `Exception` class.
[setlocale() Does Not Affect Echo Anymore](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/setlocale_with_float.html): setlocale() used to impact several functions, including `echo`.
[setlocale() Rejects Extra Arguments When $locales Is An Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/setlocaleArrayVariadicTypeError86.html): `setlocale()` accepts either a list of individual locale name arguments, or a single array of candidate locale names as its second parameter.
[sodium_crypto_pwhash_str() Throws ValueError For Out-Of-Range Limits](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/sodiumPwhashValueError86.html): The password-hashing functions `sodium_crypto_pwhash()`, `sodium_crypto_pwhash_str()`, `sodium_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256()` and `sodium_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256_str()` validate their `$opslimit` and `$memlimit` arguments against libsodium's documented minimums.
[sort() Places Integers Before Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/sort.html): sort() used the PHP 7 way to compare values: then, strings would rank below integers, in particular below 0.
[spaceship Operator Results](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/spaceship.html): With the change of comparison between integers and strings, the spaceship was also impacted.
[static Cannot Be Used Anymore In Callable Arrays](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/staticInCallable.html): PHP supports a callable syntax, based on array: it must be an array of two elements, where the index 0 is the object or the class, and the index 1 is the method name.
[str_pos() Requires Only Strings](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/str_pos.html): str_pos() accepted integers as second argument, and would convert them into their equivalent ASCII char.
[str_replace() Checks For Arguments](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/str_replaceChecksArguments.html): str_replace() can replace a string with another string.
[str_replace() Enforces Strings In Array Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/str_replaceOnArraysOfThings.html): str_replace() accepts an array of strings as third argument: it applies all the replacements to all the strings in that arguments.
[str_replace() On Arrays Of Objects](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/str_replaceOnArraysOfObjects.html): str_replace() accepts an array of strings as third argument: it applies all the replacements to all the strings in that arguments.
[str_split() Throws ValueError With Negative Lengths](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strsplitnegativelength.html): `str_split()` used to emit a warning and return `false`, when provided with `$length`, the second argument, as an integer less then 1.
[strftime() And gmstrftime() Are Deprecated](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strftime.html): `strftime()` and `gmstrftime()` format time and date according to locale settings.
[strpos() Does Not Accept False](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposWithFalse.html): PHP used to type cast `false` to 0 then to a string, when it is used as second argument to strpos().
[strpos() Does Not Accept Null As Second Parameter](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposWithNull.html): strpos() and stripos() used to accept NULL as second argument.
[strpos() Emits TypeError](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposTypeError.html): strpos() and stripos() emit a `TypeError` when the offset is of the wrong type.
[strpos() Emits ValueError](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposValueError.html): strpos() and stripos() emits a ValueError when the offset is out of range.
[strpos() With Integer Argument](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposWithInteger.html): strpos() used to accept integer arguments as second argument, `$needle`.
[strpos() With Null Haystack](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strposWithNullHaystack.html): PHP accepted `null` as first parameter `$string` of strpos().
[strpos() With Out-Of-Range Offset Is A Fatal Error](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strpos-and-offset.html): Requesting a large offset, beyond the size of the searched string, leads to a Fatal error in PHP 8.
[strsplit() With Empty String](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/strsplit.html): strsplit() splits a string into smaller strings of the same size.
[substr() Returns Empty String On Out Of Bond Offset](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/substrReturnsEmptyStringOnOutOfBondOffset.html): substr() used to return false when the parameters used to extract the string were out of bound, or well out of the string sizes.
[switch() Changed Comparison Style](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/switchComparison.html): The switch command uses a relaxed comparison style.
[throw Is An Expression](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/throwIsAnExpression.html): `throw` was a standalone expression: it needed to be alone, between semicolons (or equivalents).
[trim() Strips Form Feed By Default](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/trimFormFeed.html): `trim()`, `ltrim()` and `rtrim()` remove a fixed set of characters by default when no second argument is provided.
[unserialize() Checks The End Of The String](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unserialize_checks.html): The format used by unserialize() is a closed format: it might be smaller than the string that contains it.
[unserialize() Error Report](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unserialize_notice.html): unserialize() parses a string into a PHP data structure: array, int, object, etc.
[unserialize() `max_depth` Option](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/unserialize_max_depth.html): unserialize() has now an option to limit the depth of nesting in the decoded structure.
[usleep() Validates Its Microseconds Argument Range](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/usleepOverflowValueError86.html): `usleep()`'s `$microseconds` argument is passed to the operating system as an unsigned integer.
[var_export() Format](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/var_export.html): PHP used to export an object with a fully qualified name, except for the first backslash.
[var_export() With Stdclass](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/var_export_stdclass.html): PHP used to export stdClass objects like other classes, with a call to the magic method __set_state().
[version_compare() Stricter Operators](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/version_compare.html): version_compare() compares version strings, using an operator, passed as third parameter.
[vsprint() Requires An Array](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/vsprintfRequiresAnArray.html): vsprint() used to skip argument type validation, and wrongly report missing arguments, when the last argument was not a array.
[vsprintf() Returns Empty String On Error](https://php-changed-behaviors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/behavior/vsprintfReturnsEmptyString.html): `vsprintf()` always returns a string, or raises an exception.
